findings.text: Write only hardware breakpoint tuning equals 0x81 and read write tuning equals 0x83 while the supported breakpoint slot count equals 4 and a slot helper reports that count for any type argument.

Interrupt allocation kinds start at one for IOAPIC and continue through HPET and PCI MSI and PCI MSIX and DMAR and AMDVI and UV, with IOAPIC parameters carrying pin plus node plus level plus active low plus valid flags and UV parameters carrying limit plus blade plus offset plus name.

A unified allocation descriptor carries type plus flags plus device identifier plus hardware number plus affinity mask plus MSI descriptor plus opaque data plus a union holding either IOAPIC or UV details, while a compact vector configuration holds destination APIC identifier plus vector number.
Vector cleanup scheduling and move completion accept a vector configuration and have no observable effect in this configuration.
Vector lock acquisition and release take no arguments and perform no synchronization in this configuration, so they establish no mutual exclusion.

An IRQ trace alias names the entry start point, while vector slot markers distinguish unused as null and shutdown as minus one and retriggered as minus two, and the vector table is an array of interrupt descriptor pointers sized by the vector count.
The HyperV raw timer accessor returns an ordered processor timestamp read for use as a host time source.
Hypervisor kinds place native at zero and add VMware and Microsoft HyperV and Xen paravirtual plus Xen hardware virtualized and KVM and Jailhouse and ACRN and Bhyve.

A hypervisor descriptor holds a name plus a detection callback returning an unsigned 32 bit value plus a hypervisor kind plus initialization callbacks plus runtime callbacks plus a flag to ignore the no paravirtualization option.
One build compares a global hypervisor kind against a requested kind to test identity, while another build always reports native and makes platform initialization do nothing.
Each routed header defines a private inclusion guard so repeated inclusion is idempotent, with no runtime behavior attached to the guards.

Master command equals 0x20 and master mask equals 0x21 and slave command equals 0xa0 and slave mask equals 0xa1 and edge control registers equal 0x4d0 and 0x4d1, while status plus poll plus output control aliases all name the master command port.
Cascade input equals 2 and master default initialization equals 1 and slave default initialization equals 1 while automatic end of interrupt mode equals 2.
Master and slave cached masks expose the low and high bytes of a shared cached mask word through a byte extraction helper.
Byte port input returns the read value and byte port output writes the given value, with each access followed by a short microsecond scale stall for slow chipset compatibility.

A legacy interrupt controller descriptor holds a legacy count plus a chip pointer plus mask plus unmask plus mask all plus restore plus initialization plus probe plus pending query plus make IRQ callbacks.
Legacy presence is tested by comparing the global descriptor against a null descriptor, and the legacy count helper delegates to the descriptor count field.
A 32 bit user context holds flags plus link plus stack plus machine context plus signal mask, with the mask placed last for extensibility.

A packed 64 bit file status compatibility layout sequences device plus padding plus low inode plus mode plus link count plus user plus group plus device number plus padding plus size plus block size plus block count plus access plus modify plus change timestamps with nanoseconds plus full inode.
A marker records that the low 32 bit inode field in the compatibility status layout is unreliable, with the marker value defined as 1.

Compatibility enablement offers a global flag build where enable reads the flag and disable clears it, plus a compile time build where enable reflects 32 bit support and disable does nothing, plus a verbose check that emits a one time notice when emulation was built but is disabled.
Kernel indirect branch tracking support equals 1 when enabled and 0 when disabled, and end branch instruction size equals four times that flag so it is four when enabled and zero otherwise.

Assembly and symbolic end branch spellings select 64 bit versus 32 bit forms when enabled and empty when disabled, while a no branch attribute plus a noseal listing macro similarly collapse to empty in the disabled build.

One helper synthesizes an end branch opcode without embedding that opcode as an immediate by complementing a constant, another returns a distinct no operation encoding reserved for former end branch sites, and a predicate accepts both the poison encoding and normalized 32 or 64 bit forms.
Branch tracking save ignores its disable request and returns zero while restore ignores its saved value, preserving no processor state in this configuration.
Descriptor table alignment equals eight times one plus the branch tracking flag, and a catch all trap identifier equals 0xFFFF.
The generic table entry handler type names a function receiving a register snapshot pointer and returning nothing.

C declarations expose assembly trampolines plus visible handlers, with error code forms taking an extra code and raw forms bypassing common entry handling and IRQ plus system vector plus Xen callback forms aliasing standard shapes and IST adding a no IST companion and virtualization plus double fault plus non maskable plus machine check plus debug forms reusing raw or IST behavior, including an extended double fault form carrying an address.

Managed definitions capture entry state then run an instrumented inner routine then release entry state, while raw forms expose the handler directly and the IRQ form derives an eight bit vector from the code with conditional interrupt stack execution and system vector forms add stack handling plus a flexible return companion with a simple variant using raw enter and exit, and IST plus double fault plus non maskable plus machine check plus debug definitions reuse those shapes.

Tooling declarations emit assembler directives carrying an error code flag or expand to nothing, while a system vector installer prefers flexible return when configured and falls back to classic table installation otherwise, and the listed flexible return vectors for reschedule plus reboot plus single and broadcast calls plus threshold plus deferred error plus thermal plus IRQ work plus three KVM posted flavors plus guest mediated PMI plus posted MSI are all null in this configuration.

Isolated memory read and write masks place extended static RAM flush at bit 31 and processor snoop at bit 30 and remote unit at bit 29 and virtual channel identifiers at bits 15 through 8 and SMM processor at bit 1 and non SMM processor at bit 0 with no access as zero, while full read access equals 0xBFFFFFFF and full write access equals 0xFFFFFFFF.
Quark isolated memory geometry allows eight regions with register base 0x40 and alignment 0x400, with a mask equal to alignment minus one.

Opcode table size equals 256 and group table size equals 8, while prefix tags assign operand size to one and repeat equal to two and repeat not equal to three and lock to four and code segment to five and data segment to six and extra segment to seven and FS to eight and GS to nine and stack segment to ten and address size to eleven.

Slow chipset accesses require a post access stall, the compatibility low inode must not be trusted, poison encodings are intentionally recognized as end branch sites, IRQ vectors keep only the low byte of the code, and cached master and slave masks alias bytes of one shared word so updates interact.
